purpose: Five room-fit hero floor source images for the five official Human Protocol big-room themes. Each image has the same aspect ratio as the target room bounds.
sourcePolicy: Source images only. Runtime integration should place each image on a single room-sized floor plane or GLB surface with matching meters; do not stretch a square texture over a rectangular room.
